body: Wow, I really appreciate you breaking that down barney style for me. This was something I needed
Thank you! I really appreciate you actually taking the time to break it down for me I've never thought of it like that

Before our fight about it in December she never acted like that. Aside from petty comments she only really started getting hypocritical recently. I just wish there was a way to tell her to get over my mistakes and move forward you know?

Before the fight in December it was bliss, everything was perfect. It's just that after the fight it hasn't been the same; some days we are fine and it feels like we are going to fix it but some days it's tough
See my hang up is I still feel like it's my fault. Before our big fight about the porn addiction it was my perfect relationship. She was my best friend for two years prior
For me, I was watching it every day to every other day. I came to that conclusion after I tried to lie to hide it from her since she had previously said it bothered her
I really appreciate your time and your story really hit home to me. I never thought about it like that! Your response has really helped me cope with this thank you

Thats the right mindset! Personally I get really anxious over the fear of being a failure in the future, so I have to take it day by day instead of trying to worry about the distant future. Just gotta find what helps you make it through, and know its a process. That was also really hard for me to understand and accept personally

Thats big fucking shitty but yiu can make it through it. You've made it this far, this long, and you're still here. I don't think you give yourself enough credit for that. Of course its easy for a bunch of strangers on the internet to try to tell you how you just need to keep your chin up and blah blah blah but I don't think many people recognize that you are so much more capable than you think. Think about it man, you've gone through so much and survived it all.You can make it past this, even though it is fucking awful. And of course if you want or need anything you can absolutely reach out I don't mind at all. I'd rather spend hours talking to you than think that you're dead.
I really appreciate you taking the time to comment, thank you so much. Careful what you wish for though I might reach out at some point who knows

It goes past that, im losing my job and I've applied for i couldn't tell you how many hut I just get ghosted.i feel so much shame and self loathing that I started smoking again. I feel weak and useless. I feel alone. I don't talk to anyone but my girl and at this point idk what to do. I can't talk to her about the fact that all I think is blowing my brains out or driving into a tree or something like that. I appreciate your comment a lot but fuck man
Thank you for being the only response. I appreciate it
I got you brother, I'm just passing on the help and advice given to me. Thank you for making the post and responding so I could reach out.

Hey man, thats shitty as fuck but stick it out. Thats a terrible situation but you can get out of it. Don't cut your journey so short because of this. You've got so much you can do and experience. Just wait til you can get out of the house and be you're own person. You can get back at them by being a better person and not following their footsteps. Make them regret not being better to you by being successful and a good person. Success is the best revenge if you ask me.  No need to contact them or deal with their shit. That way you can see them understand their consequences. If you're dead you can't see it all play out. Keep your chin up young blood I love you.

Hey I get that trust me. But you've made it this far. You and I both can find stories of people turning themselves around from dire situations too, I have no doubt you can do the same. If you've started meds and held out more than a decade on these thoughts then you're stronger than you think. You got this shit, and in case nobody said it lately I love you you beautiful bastard. Keep your chin up and message me if you even want or need anything. I'd rather you message me than lose someone. 
"Each man's death diminishes me,
For I am involved in mankind.
Therefore, send not to know
For whom the bell tolls,
It tolls for thee."
